notes: Japan 1961, ja narration, colour, Tokyo Cinema for Matsushita (music 矢代秋雄): the principle of television, its manufacture and the road to colour. Windows: Yagi antennas against the sky, then a sync-pulse waveform; the long window is the RCA Indian-head test card on a CRT, first clean and then drowning in snow as the signal weakens, then valves; an oscilloscope pulse and coil winding at the Matsushita works; full-frame colour bars and a colour-bar monitor at an engineer's console; a colour camera and the three red, green and blue guns; a picture tube glowing on the finishing line.
